title: Claude Fable 5 & Opus 4.8
content:
## Overview

Claude Fable 5 and Claude Opus 4.8 are the two frontier releases from Anthropic in 2026. Fable 5 (June 9, 2026) is the first model in Anthropic's new **Mythos class** — a tier above Opus — and represents the current capability frontier. Opus 4.8 (May 28, 2026) is the most capable **generally available** model across all major cloud platforms.

---

## Claude Opus 4.8

Released May 28, 2026, Opus 4.8 is the successor to Opus 4.7 and the standard top-tier model available without restriction via the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Microsoft Foundry.

**Key specs:**
- **Context window:** 1M tokens (default on Claude API, Bedrock, Vertex AI; 200K on Microsoft Foundry)
- **Max output tokens:** 128K
- **Pricing:** $5 / $25 per million input / output tokens
- **Model ID:** `claude-opus-4-8`

**New capabilities with Opus 4.8:**
- **Mid-conversation system messages:** You can now send `role: "system"` messages at any position in the `messages` array (after a user turn), without breaking prompt cache hits. Useful for injecting updated instructions mid-task without restarting the conversation.
- Fast mode for Opus 4.7 has been deprecated with removal on July 24, 2026; migrate to Opus 4.8 for equivalent throughput.

---

## Claude Fable 5

Released June 9, 2026, Fable 5 is Anthropic's most capable publicly released model. It introduces the **Mythos class** — a new capability tier above Opus — and is the first Claude model to ship with **always-on adaptive thinking** and a default **1-million-token context window**.

**Key specs:**
- **Context window:** 1M tokens
- **Max output tokens:** 128K
- **Pricing:** $10 / $50 per million input / output tokens (approximately 2× Opus 4.8)
- **Model ID:** `claude-fable-5`
- **Thinking:** Always-on adaptive thinking (not a separate mode)

### Benchmark Performance

Fable 5 achieves state-of-the-art results on nearly every benchmark tested:

| Benchmark | Fable 5 | Opus 4.8 | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index | 65 | — | Ahead of GPT-5.5 (60) and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview (57) |
| SWE-Bench Pro | +11 pts vs Opus 4.8 | baseline | Long, complex software engineering tasks |
| FrontierCode | ~2× Opus 4.8 | baseline | Complex code generation |
| Spatial reasoning | 38.6% | 14.5% | Nearly 3× improvement |
| Legal reasoning | 13.3% | — | GPT-5.5: 2.1%, Gemini: 0.0% |

---

## Safety Architecture: Mythos Class

Fable 5 and **Claude Mythos 5** share the same underlying model weights. The only difference is the safety layer applied at inference time:

- **Fable 5** — Anthropic's production safety classifiers active (cybersecurity, biology/chemistry, model distillation misuse)
- **Mythos 5** — Same model without safety classifiers; available only through Project Glasswing in limited access

When a Fable 5 request triggers a safety classifier, it is automatically re-answered by Claude Opus 4.8 and the user is notified. Anthropic reports this fallback occurs in fewer than 5% of sessions.

---

## Availability Note (June 2026)

On June 12, 2026, the US government directed Anthropic to suspend access by foreign nationals to Fable 5 and Mythos 5. Anthropic responded by disabling both models for all users while implementing compliant access controls. Claude Opus 4.8 remains available without restriction during this period. Check the [Anthropic status page](https://status.anthropic.com) for current model availability.
